topic: London campaign demo preparation and follow-up
summary_markdown:
A demonstration of a campaign in London is scheduled for June 12th. The discussion focused on preparing and fixing the necessary elements for this demo, confirming that existing Brazilian assets are suitable for use in London. A follow-up call was arranged to coordinate preparation efforts.

Later, it was discussed that traffic and frame data (as previously agreed upon) need to be provided starting Monday.
decisions: A campaign demonstration is scheduled for London on June 12th.
The team will hold a call to plan the preparation work leading up to the demo.
Traffic and frame data must be delivered starting Monday.
action_items: Schedule a follow-up call (suggested for tomorrow at 9:30 AM).
Gather and provide traffic and frame data starting Monday.
